surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the sequential exposure of reactants to the carbon nanocoil templates, leading to the formation of oxide layers through atomic layer deposition. The process includes the adsorption of metal precursors and oxidizing agents, followed by surface reactions that form the oxide layers. The Kirkendall effect was observed during the solid-state reaction between Al2O3 and ZnO layers, resulting in the formation of ZnAl2O4 spinel nanotubes.
